title: Fruit Flavored Drink, Powdered, Not Reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: The fruit flavored drink in powder form (not reconstituted) is a dry blend of flavorings, sweeteners, and sometimes vitamin additives. The powder retains a bright fruit taste and aroma and can be used in culinary applications without adding water.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Powdered drinks are convenient for transport and storage because they do not require a liquid component.
A wide range of flavors is available: orange, lemon, strawberry, mango, and more.
Some versions are fortified with vitamin C and other micronutrients.
The powder is often used in sports nutrition for a quick energy boost.
Unlike ready‑to‑drink beverages, the powder allows you to control concentration and calorie content.

items.title: Source of Vitamin C
items.content: Certain variants are enriched with vitamin C, which supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Energy Support
items.content: Sugars and fast‑acting carbohydrates provide rapid replenishment of energy stores after exercise.

items.title: Convenient Consumption
items.content: The powder is easy to dose and add to foods, simplifying control over intake.

items.title: Sugar Content
items.content: Most powders contain added sugars, which may be undesirable for people with diabetes or those limiting calories.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Flavorings or sweeteners in the blend can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Vitamin Overdose
items.content: Frequent consumption of fortified versions may lead to excess intake of certain vitamins, such as vitamin C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The powder can be mixed into yogurt, oatmeal, smoothies, or baked goods. If desired, it can be dissolved in a small amount of water or juice, but this is not required.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed container. Keep moisture out to prevent clumping and loss of flavor.
